title: sil shopping_search — request

domain.description: Sends the leaf, or the kind above its leaves when the question is which kind; a shelf, domain or top answers `not_a_leaf`.

spec.description: Sends a spec the domain read listed, unchanged: a part’s by its path (`boiler.boilerVolume`).

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this spec.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the spec's type.

specs.description: Sends every settled want: a spec from the domain read, one of its operators, a value in its unit or its set; on a kind, `leaf` in or nin its leaves.

min.description: The low end, in the minor unit.

max.description: The high end, in the minor unit.

currency.description: Both ends in this currency; sil converts nothing.

price.description: Keeps variants with an offer in this currency within one or both ends; sil converts nothing.

query.description: Sends the words the buyer used for what no spec holds — a name, a model, "travel" — matched against the products’ titles and words.

n.description: Asks for this many products, at most 10; default 5.

brief.description: Ties the call to a brief in sil’s record; never required.

description: Money is in the minor unit: €130 is 13000.
